scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f tooling/docker-compose.yml --project-directory . up -d --wait && docker compose -f tooling/docker-compose.yml --project-directory . run --rm minio-init
scripts.infra:up:ai: docker compose -f tooling/docker-compose.yml --project-directory . --profile ai up -d --wait && docker compose -f tooling/docker-compose.yml --project-directory . run --rm minio-init
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f tooling/docker-compose.yml --project-directory . --profile ai --profile init down --remove-orphans
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:int && pnpm test:contract && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:load && pnpm test:mutation
